title: Fixed Long Throat and Paired Bead Roll Former
description: One newly authored whole fixed pedestal-mounted manual bead-roller-style exterior. A slender long horizontal open-throat plate sits above a full upright pedestal and broad chamfered finite base. Two complete parallel longitudinal shafts run through four separate raised bearing blocks and carry two entire short profiled forming rolls at the forward ends: one raised centre bead and one recessed circumferential groove, with an intentional empty static display gap. A rear shaft crank with a full offset grip and a proud upper adjustment screw-style stem with cross handle complete the whole machine. Not the old upright triangular three-roll ring former or deep tall English-wheel C frame: this has long parallel driven-shaft exteriors, small paired front tooling and a rear crank; all geometry newly authored and none imported. One static model zero scenes. No sheet or stock supplied. No rotation, gear transmission, thread engagement, pressure, forming process, nip compatibility, adjustment travel, capacity, strength, stability, installation, mounting, manufacture, ergonomics, engineering or safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
